meta.name: grpo-rl-training
meta.description: Expert guidance for GRPO/RL fine-tuning with TRL for reasoning and task-specific model training

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用强化学习微调大语言模型提升推理能力
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fine-tune LLMs with reinforcement learning for reasoning tasks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 TRL 库对语言模型进行 GRPO 强化学习微调，包括设计奖励函数、配置训练参数、处理数据集和部署模型。
howto.when: 当你需要微调模型以强制执行特定输出格式、教授可验证任务（如数学、编程）或改进推理能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRPO 微调模型，让它输出带 XML 标签的推理过程。
say.note: Claude 会指导你设置格式奖励函数。

say.text: 设计一个奖励函数，奖励数学题的正确答案。
say.note: Claude 会提供正确性奖励函数模板。

say.text: 配置 GRPO 训练参数，使用 8 个生成和 LoRA。
say.note: Claude 会给出内存优化的训练配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through GRPO/RL fine-tuning of language models using the TRL library, including designing reward functions, configuring training parameters, preparing datasets, and deploying models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to fine-tune a model to enforce specific output formats, teach verifiable tasks (e.g., math, coding), or improve reasoning capabilities.

say_en.text: Help me fine-tune a model with GRPO to output reasoning with XML tags.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on setting up format reward functions.

say_en.text: Design a reward function that rewards correct answers for math problems.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a correctness reward function template.

say_en.text: Configure GRPO training arguments with 8 generations and LoRA.
say_en.note: Claude will give a memory-optimized training config.
